run_network.template:
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny network*)
(allow network-bind (local tcp "localhost:{tcp}") (local tcp "localhost:{bucket}"))
(allow network-inbound (local tcp "localhost:{tcp}") (local tcp "localhost:{bucket}"))
(allow network-outbound (remote tcp "localhost:{tcp}") (remote tcp "localhost:{bucket}"))

field_semantics.auxiliary_request: Auxiliary fields describe the current actual auxiliary request. On replacement, requests[1] changes; durable_ops[1], ownership_ops[1], positions[1], durable_positions[1], durable_verdicts[1], ownership_verdicts[1], proof_sources[1] and release_verdicts[1] reset. The AuxLocal, AuxOutputSubmitted, AuxDurableSuccess, AuxOwnershipSuccess, AuxOutputReleased, AuxFinishProcessed, AuxInactive, AuxFinishDisposed and AuxSyncDisposed bits and first ordinals reset; the global ordinal remains monotonic. Native/root disposition counts remain invocation-wide.
field_semantics.disposal_masks: roots_disposed records concrete task/channel/result/abandon payload disposal and bookkeeping closure; native_disposed records concrete native child payload disposal. Notification Wakers and remaining context aliases are excluded. Only OriginalRequestDropped and the existing Weak<Request> summary witness final owner-alias destruction before A2Free.
field_semantics.public_guard: Immutable admission provenance: this invocation was admitted with a PublicRequestGuard. This is not a current-live assertion; actual destruction is recorded only by PublicGuardDropped and its first ordinal.
field_semantics.request_dead: Current read-time summary from the existing Weak<Request> witness; false does not prove activity and true does not establish A2 Free, public-guard destruction, or external reuse.

observe_request_v2.v1: exact previous requests and response behavior preserved; v2 Begin refuses

observations.refusal: 0 means none; current closed Refusal discriminant+1. Never interpreted as successful disposal.

structured_stream.event_array: 64 Option<Event> entries; first count entries present, rest null; original A2 Event tuples/enum names unchanged.
